title: G7 complete preflight accepted a pooled retry protocol
evidence: Before repair, a valid complete G7 fixture with every retry_protocol changed to pooled returned formal_run_allowed_by_protocol=true with errors=[] under require_complete_plan=True. That could silently mix a retry batch with the original formal batch instead of preserving the required separate non-pooled boundary.
remediation: Require exact retry_protocol=separate_frozen_retry_not_pooled for every complete-plan row, add an adversarial pooled-protocol test, and independently verify the immutable formal plan.
